newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX to begin automated trading of Nikkei futures.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX to begin automated trading of Nikkei futures.

text.p: The Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) said on Thursday it would begin trading Nikkei 225 and Nikkei 300 stock index futures on its automated system from September 3, 1997.

SIMEX said in a statement Nikkei futures would be traded electronically between 0700 GMT and 1100 GMT, extending trading hours for the contracts beyond the existing open outcry session, which ends at 0615 GMT.
The exchange signed an agreement on July 22 with Nihon Keizai Shimbun, the proprietor of the Nikkei stock indices, for trading to begin in September, it said.
The extension of trading hours would boost the exchange's efforts to position itself as the centre of equity index futures trading in Asia, the statement said.
SIMEX launched stock index futures based on the Taiwan MSCI stock index in January.
